name: Budget
description: Monthly budgets per account, charts of actuals against budget and account balances, and AI forecasts of next month that you review before they become budgets.

fields.label: Charts and alerts
fields.help: How far back charts and forecasts look, and when the dashboard warns that an expense account is close to its budget for the month.

fields.label: AI forecast
fields.help: Known changes the AI should take into account, e.g. "Rent rises to $2,100 from January" or "No travel in December".
